Generate a table with details about executed Monolix runs

Source: R/runs_table.R
runs_table.Rd

Creates a formatted table displaying information about Monolix jobs that have been submitted and recorded in the run store. The table can include basic job information or detailed file tracking data.

Usage

runs_table(
  store = default_store(),
  format = "gt",
  output_file = NULL,
  include_files = FALSE,
  ignore_failed_runs = FALSE,
  latest_only = FALSE,
  include_summary = FALSE
)

Arguments

store

Character scalar. The run store directory (see default_store()). Defaults to default_store(). Nothing is written to it.

format

Character scalar. Output format for the table. Either "gt" for a formatted gt table (default) or "csv" for a data frame.

output_file

Character scalar or NULL. File path to save output.

include_files

Logical scalar. Whether to include details about input and output files in the table. Default is FALSE.

ignore_failed_runs

Logical scalar. Whether to exclude runs where completed_at is missing or the run finished without results (i.e., failed, incomplete or "no_results" runs). Default is FALSE.

latest_only

Logical scalar. Whether to return only the latest run (by submitted_at) for each project file. Default is FALSE.

include_summary

Logical scalar. Whether to include the statistics parsed from the run's results (see runs_data()). Default is FALSE.

Value

When format = "gt", returns a gt_tbl object. When format = "csv" and output_file is specified, returns the data frame invisibly after writing to file. When format = "csv" and output_file is NULL, returns the data frame. Returns NULL invisibly if no runs are found in the store.

See also

runs_data for extracting the underlying data, mono for submitting Monolix jobs and recording runs, default_store for the default run store

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Table of all runs
runs_table()

# Table with input/output file information
runs_table(include_files = TRUE)

# Table excluding failed runs
runs_table(ignore_failed_runs = TRUE)

# Table showing only latest run per project file
runs_table(latest_only = TRUE)

# Table with the parsed run statistics
runs_table(include_summary = TRUE)

# Export to CSV
runs_table(format = "csv", output_file = "runs_summary.csv")

# Read the store of another folder
runs_table(store = "/path/to/monolix/.mlxtrx")
} # }
